title: Permutation-symmetric quantum trajectories
summary: We show how one may perform a stochastic unravelling which respects weak permutation symmetry for general models of $N$ emitters coupled to a common system (e.g. a cavity mode). Our work extends prior work by Zhang et al. [2018 New J. Phys. 20 112001] which provided an efficient quantum jump approach for a restricted subset of such problems. For problems involving $2$-level emitters, such an unravelling reduces the computational cost from $\mathcal{O}(N^5)$ to $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$, and with additional refinements, allows reduction to $\mathcal{O}(N)$.
